fields.title: Columns to transform
fields.description:
Select the nominal columns that should be included in the transformation.
For each included column extra columns are appended, one for each possible value.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove included columns from output
fields.description: When enabled, the original columns selected for transformation are removed from the output. The included columns are replaced by the new generated columns.
